defect: The visible stem carries an overt dative PP (`a nadie`, `a tu hermano`, `a los niños`) with no parenthetical hint, so dative clitic doubling is optional — both the ±se forms are standard Spanish. Each row stores exactly one of them as `correctAnswer` with no `acceptableAnswers`, so only the keyed form reaches the deterministic short-circuit (infra/lambda/src/routes/exercises.ts); the other falls to the LLM evaluator, which anchors on `correctAnswer` and invents a rule to justify it. Paired probe over the real evaluateAnswer (3 reps each, prod-equivalent prompts): 97414536 penalises the undoubled form 0.55/0.55/0.5 saying `se` is REQUIRED; 1b3e436b penalises the doubled form 1/0.45/1 saying `se` DOESN'T BELONG. Same construction, opposite rulings, key is the only variable.
